result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The one clear visual defect is in the first 'Fastest near you' card, where the time badge overlaps the food image awkwardly. A few minor contrast and consistency concerns also remain. The clipped carousel items and chips are expected scroll behavior and are not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card's '15–25 min' badge sits on top of the poké bowl plate and covers part of it. The badge's left offset also looks inconsistent with the other cards, where it sits clear of the dish.
issues.suggestion: Position the time badges consistently, for example bottom-left with uniform padding, and keep them from covering the main subject of the image.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen', '(500+)') and the search placeholder are light gray on white or light gray, giving low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5:1.

issues.description: The inactive bottom-nav labels (Search, Orders, Profile) and icons are low-contrast gray. The heart icon on the pizza card sits on a dark translucent circle over a busy image, which makes it hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast of inactive nav items. Give the favorite button a more opaque background.

issues.description: The promo banner has decorative circles that look cut off and overlap unevenly at the right and bottom edges. The white text over the lighter green area on the right has reduced contrast.
issues.suggestion: Align the decorative shapes cleanly and keep text over the darker background area.
